title: Sky-Isle Cleanup
description: Navigate the grid and clean all trash tiles to restore the island.

tier1.text: Watch where your bot is facing!

tier2.text: Grid coordinates: (column, row). Your bot starts at (1,1).

ngssPractices: Science and Engineering Practice 5: Using Mathematics and Computational Thinking

title: Solar Panel Path
description: Clean the dusty solar panels lined up in a row. Use a Repeat block so your program stays short.

tier1.text: Do you see a pattern? Move, clean, move, clean...

tier2.text: A Repeat block runs the blocks inside it again and again. Count the panels to pick the number.

ngssPractices: Science and Engineering Practice 5: Using Mathematics and Computational Thinking
Science and Engineering Practice 6: Constructing Explanations and Designing Solutions

title: Water Wheel Village
description: Water every garden bed around the village square. Repeat a pattern inside another pattern to cover the whole square.

tier1.text: The beds make a square. How many sides does a square have?

tier2.text: Put one Repeat block inside another: the inside loop waters one side, the outside loop does all 4 sides.

ngssPractices: Science and Engineering Practice 5: Using Mathematics and Computational Thinking
5-ESS3-1: Obtain and combine information about ways individual communities use science ideas to protect the Earth's resources and environment

title: Wind Farm Ridge
description: Rotate each wind turbine to face the wind and feed the town's power grid. Reach the target energy output.

tier1.text: Look at the wind arrows. Which way are the turbines pointing?

tier2.text: A turbine makes the most energy when it faces straight into the wind. Each rotation turns it 90 degrees.

ngssPractices: Science and Engineering Practice 2: Developing and Using Models
4-PS3-4: Apply scientific ideas to design, test, and refine a device that converts energy from one form to another

title: Recycling Plant Sort
description: Items roll down the conveyor. Use If / Else blocks so your bot cleans recyclables and moves past everything else.

tier1.text: Not every item is the same. What is different about the recyclables?

tier2.text: If something is true, the bot does the first action. Else it does the second one.

ngssPractices: Science and Engineering Practice 4: Analyzing and Interpreting Data
5-ESS3-1: Obtain and combine information about ways individual communities use science ideas to protect the Earth's resources and environment

title: Hydro Dam Hydraulics
description: Open the dam gates in the right order to keep the reservoir level safe while spinning the hydro generator. Balance water flow in and out.

tier1.text: Watch the water gauge. Is it rising faster or slower than it drains?

tier2.text: Water in minus water out = change in level. Open a gate when the level gets too high.

ngssPractices: Science and Engineering Practice 2: Developing and Using Models
Science and Engineering Practice 5: Using Mathematics and Computational Thinking
4-ESS3-1: Obtain and combine information to describe that energy and fuels are derived from natural resources

title: Bridge Builder Canyon
description: Place bridge supports so the eco-truck can cross the canyon. The bridge must hold the load without bending too far.

tier1.text: Where does the bridge sag the most when the truck drives on it?

tier2.text: Triangles are strong shapes. Build one support pattern as a subroutine and call it for every gap.

ngssPractices: Science and Engineering Practice 6: Constructing Explanations and Designing Solutions
3-5-ETS1-2: Generate and compare multiple possible solutions to a problem based on how well each is likely to meet the criteria and constraints
3-5-ETS1-3: Plan and carry out fair tests in which variables are controlled and failure points are considered

title: Compost Garden Sensors
description: Program a garden helper that runs forever: read the moisture sensor and water only the dry plants to save water.

tier1.text: Some plants look droopy, others look fine. Does every plant need water?

tier2.text: A sensor gives your bot information. If moisture is below the line, then water. 'Always' keeps checking.

ngssPractices: Science and Engineering Practice 3: Planning and Carrying Out Investigations
Science and Engineering Practice 4: Analyzing and Interpreting Data

title: Night Grid Balancer
description: When night falls the solar panels stop. Check the battery charge and switch the town between solar, wind and stored energy so the lights never go out.

tier1.text: Watch the battery meter when the sun goes down. What happens?

tier2.text: Store extra energy in the day and use it at night. Make one subroutine for day and one for night.

ngssPractices: Science and Engineering Practice 2: Developing and Using Models
4-ESS3-1: Obtain and combine information to describe that energy and fuels are derived from natural resources and their uses affect the environment

title: Eco-City Master Mission
description: Bring the whole Eco-City online: clean the streets, water the parks and power the town using everything you have learned, with as few blocks as possible.

tier1.text: Break the big mission into smaller jobs. Which job is the most urgent?

tier2.text: Reuse your best ideas: make a subroutine for each job, then call them from one Always loop.

ngssPractices: Science and Engineering Practice 1: Asking Questions and Defining Problems
Science and Engineering Practice 6: Constructing Explanations and Designing Solutions
